name: WKB-based Multiple Scattering Approximation
aliases: WKB expansion of the path integral
definition: An approximation for multiple scattering in participating media that replaces integration over complete $(x_0, 	ilde{	heta}_0)$-space with integration over a reduced subset selected by a set of Multiple Path Points (MPPs), relying on the assumption that single scattered light distribution is strongly forward peaked.
